summary: Regenerex Pharma, Inc. filed a Form 8-K under Item 8.01 to update shareholders on its delinquent SEC periodic reports. The company completed and filed its FY2025 Form 10-K after the deadline and is still working to file its Q1 and Q2 2026 Form 10-Qs, which are overdue. It also failed to file Form 12b-25 late notifications. Management attributes delays to extensive accounting and reconciliation work. No operational or strategic changes are anticipated. The filing is a routine status update on reporting compliance, not a special situation.
